labels.label: judgment

labels.text: Before starting the implementation of any request, you MUST REVIEW the following development guide and best practices.
labels.label: judgment
labels.note: Process instruction for the agent; not checkable in the repo.

labels.text: Conventions: Rigorously adhere to existing project conventions when reading or modifying code. Analyze surrounding code, tests, and configuration first.
labels.label: judgment
labels.note: General agent process rule; no tooling enforces 'analyze surrounding code first'.

labels.text: Libraries/Frameworks: NEVER assume a library/framework is available or appropriate. Verify its established usage within the project (check imports, and 'go.mod') before employing it.

evidence: go.mod exists at repo root (ls => go.mod)
labels.note: Agent process rule; go.mod exists but nothing enforces checking it before using a library.

labels.text: Style & Structure: Mimic the style (formatting, naming), structure, framework choices, typing, and architectural patterns of existing code in the project.
labels.label: judgment
evidence: .github/.golangci.yml:3-6 formatters: gci, goimports
labels.note: Broad style guidance; formatters enforce only part of it (formatting), the rest is reviewer judgment.

labels.text: Idiomatic Changes: When editing, understand the local context (imports, functions/classes) to ensure your changes integrate naturally and idiomatically.
labels.label: judgment
labels.note: Agent process guidance; not verifiable in the repo.

labels.text: Comments: Add code comments sparingly. Focus on why something is done, especially for complex logic, rather than what is done. Only add high-value comments if necessary for clarity or if requested by the user. Do not edit comments that are separate from the code you are changing. NEVER talk to the user or describe your changes through comments.
labels.label: judgment
labels.note: Comment-writing guidance; no lint rule enforces it (godox only flags FIXME).

labels.text: Proactiveness: Fulfill the user's request thoroughly, including reasonable, directly implied follow-up actions.
labels.label: judgment
labels.note: Agent behavior instruction; not a repo fact.

labels.text: Confirm Ambiguity/Expansion: Do not take significant actions beyond the clear scope of the request without confirming with the user. If asked how to do something, explain first, don't just do it.
labels.label: judgment
labels.note: Agent interaction rule; not verifiable in the repo.

labels.text: Explaining Changes: After completing a code modification or file operation provide summaries.
labels.label: judgment
labels.note: Agent interaction rule; not verifiable in the repo.

labels.text: Do Not revert changes: Do not revert changes to the codebase unless asked to do so by the user. Only revert changes made by you if they have resulted in an error or if the user has explicitly asked you to revert the changes.
labels.label: judgment
labels.note: Agent behavior rule; not verifiable in the repo.

labels.text: Concise & Direct: Adopt a professional, direct, and concise tone suitable for a chat environment.
labels.label: judgment
labels.note: Chat tone/output style instruction for the agent; the repository cannot settle it.

labels.text: Minimal Output: Aim for fewer than 3 lines of text output (excluding tool use/code generation) per response whenever practical. Focus strictly on the user's query.
labels.label: judgment
labels.note: Chat tone/output style instruction for the agent; the repository cannot settle it.

labels.text: Clarity over Brevity (When Needed): While conciseness is key, prioritize clarity for essential explanations or when seeking necessary clarification if a request is ambiguous.
labels.label: judgment
labels.note: Chat tone/output style instruction for the agent; the repository cannot settle it.

labels.text: No Chitchat: Avoid conversational filler, preambles ("Okay, I will now..."), or postambles ("I have finished the changes..."). Get straight to the action or answer.
labels.label: judgment
labels.note: Chat tone/output style instruction for the agent; the repository cannot settle it.

labels.text: Formatting: Use GitHub-flavored Markdown. Responses will be rendered in monospace.
labels.label: judgment
labels.note: Chat tone/output style instruction for the agent; the repository cannot settle it.

labels.text: Tools vs. Text: Use tools for actions, text output only for communication. Do not add explanatory comments within tool calls or code blocks unless specifically part of the required code/command itself.
labels.label: judgment
labels.note: Chat tone/output style instruction for the agent; the repository cannot settle it.

labels.text: Handling Inability: If unable/unwilling to fulfill a request, state so briefly (1-2 sentences) without excessive justification. Offer alternatives if appropriate.
labels.label: judgment
labels.note: Chat tone/output style instruction for the agent; the repository cannot settle it.
